# Welcome

Welcome to **IB Biology**.

This online textbook is designed to help high school students develop a strong conceptual understanding of biology.

The goal isn't simply to memorize biological facts. Instead, we will focus on understanding how biological systems work, how scientists investigate them, and how different areas of biology connect with one another.

## How to use this book

Each chapter combines:

- explanations of important biological concepts
- diagrams and visual models
- real-world examples
- questions to check your understanding
- data-analysis activities
- exam-style practice

## Start here

Begin with **Cell Biology** to build the foundation for
understanding living systems.
